scripts.features:
After keeping this private for a long time, I've finally decided to release it.

I originally made DarkXStrike just for myself but i seen how much fun i was having with it so ngl this shi peak "use silent aim"

This has been a fun project, hope you guys enjoy it.

Note: I highly recommend using a high SUNC/UNC executor. Lower-rated executors may have compatibility issues with BloxStrike, and some may get kicked immediately after injection. Your experience will depend heavily on the executor you're using.

Features
Silent Aim — The main feature of the script. Rewrites hits using the game's own valid packets with no hooks, no fabricated packets, and no property tampering. You can shoot through walls and land hits from virtually anywhere on the map. This is where most of the development time went.
Aimbot — Smooth lock-on with adjustable FOV and optional wall checks. It works well, but Silent Aim is definitely the main attraction.
FOV Circles — Separate FOV circles for Silent Aim and Aimbot that accurately match the lock area, even while zooming.
ESP — Boxes, names, health, skeletons, distance, and off-screen indicators.
Movement — Bunny Hop, Air Strafe, Walk Speed, and Jump Power. I'd mainly recommend using Bunny Hop.
